# Rising Company Design System

> One brand, two themes. Same type pairing, same spacing, same voice, same token names —
> only the palette and the amount of chrome change.
>
> - **Mission** (dark) — mission control / technical HUD. Internal and operator-facing surfaces.
> - **Daylight** (light) — same system in daylight. Public and user-facing surfaces.
>
> **Animation quality is the first priority of the design.** Motion is designed before it is
> written, built on [Motion](https://motion.dev), and a still view beats a careless one.
> See "Motion" below.

## Themes

Themes are a **product decision, not a viewer preference**. A product picks one theme and
commits to it. Both themes expose the *same variable names*, so every component below is
written once and works in either.

### Picking a theme

| Use it for | Theme |
|---|---|
| Operator consoles, dashboards, diagram/map views, admin, internal tools | **Mission** |
| Anything an external user lands on: marketing, landing pages, onboarding, sign-in for non-staff | **Daylight** |
| Long-form reading, forms, data entry, docs, anything used in a bright room or on a projector | **Daylight** |
| Ambient / always-on displays, monitoring walls, low-light rooms | **Mission** |

Rules of thumb:

- **If a stranger sees it first, it's Daylight.** A cold visitor should not be met with a
  black screen and a bare input. Sign-in is the *end* of a landing page, not a substitute
  for one.
- **If the user is already logged in and doing operator work, it's Mission.**
- A product may ship both — Daylight for its public/marketing surface and Mission for the
  app behind the login. Switch at the auth boundary, not per-page.
- A Daylight product **may** offer Mission as an opt-in user dark mode. A Mission product
  must not silently flip to Daylight.

### Applying a theme

Set `data-theme` on the root element. `mission` is the default when the attribute is absent.

```html
<html data-theme="daylight">
```

```css
/* ---- Mission (default / dark) ---- */
:root, [data-theme="mission"] {
  --bg-base: #0a0c10;
  --bg-surface: #0d1117;
  --bg-surface-hover: #0f1520;
  --bg-inset: #0a1410;

  --border: #1a2a20;
  --border-hover: #2a4a38;
  --border-subtle: #1a3020;
  --border-grid: #111820;

  --text-heading: #e8f4ff;
  --text-body: #c8d8e8;
  --text-muted: #84a89a;
  --text-subtle: #7d9b8c;
  --text-label: #6e8f80;
  --text-dim: #61856d;

  --accent: #3af0a0;            /* brand fill — identical in both themes */
  --accent-hover: #6ff7be;      /* --accent under hover */
  --accent-ink: #3af0a0;        /* accent as text / icon / border */
  --accent-on: #08150f;         /* text on top of --accent */
  --accent-wash: #3af0a014;     /* accent @ 8%  */
  --accent-line: #3af0a050;     /* accent @ 31% */
  --accent-bracket: #3af0a040;  /* accent @ 25% */

  --accent-2: #2a7adf;
  --accent-2-ink: #2a7adf;
  --danger: #ff4a24;
  --danger-ink: #ff4a24;
  --danger-wash: #ff4a2414;
  --danger-line: #ff4a2450;
  --warning: #f5b83d;
  --warning-ink: #f5b83d;
  --warning-wash: #f5b83d14;
  --warning-line: #f5b83d50;

  --gradient: linear-gradient(90deg, #3af0a0, #2a7adf);
  --card-shadow: none;                     /* elevation is background shift only */

  --chrome-scanline: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);  /* scanline stripe color */
  --chrome-bracket-display: block;         /* corner brackets on */
  --chrome-glow: rgba(58, 240, 160, 0.05); /* atmosphere radial */
  --chrome-grid-line: rgba(17, 24, 32, 0.7); /* atmosphere grid */
}

/* ---- Daylight (light) ---- */
[data-theme="daylight"] {
  --bg-base: #f6f8f7;
  --bg-surface: #ffffff;
  --bg-surface-hover: #eef3f0;
  --bg-inset: #e8f5ee;

  --border: #dde5e0;
  --border-hover: #9dc4b0;
  --border-subtle: #e6ede9;
  --border-grid: #e9efeb;

  --text-heading: #0b1a14;
  --text-body: #26332d;
  --text-muted: #43564c;
  --text-subtle: #4a5d54;
  --text-label: #52655b;
  --text-dim: #61746b;

  --accent: #3af0a0;
  --accent-hover: #22dc8c;      /* --accent under hover */
  --accent-ink: #0b7a4e;        /* mint is illegible on white — text/borders darken */
  --accent-on: #08150f;
  --accent-wash: #0b7a4e12;
  --accent-line: #0b7a4e45;
  --accent-bracket: #0b7a4e30;

  --accent-2: #2a7adf;
  --accent-2-ink: #1f5fbf;
  --danger: #ff4a24;
  --danger-ink: #c02a10;
  --danger-wash: #c02a1012;
  --danger-line: #c02a1045;
  --warning: #f5b83d;
  --warning-ink: #8a5a00;
  --warning-wash: #8a5a0012;
  --warning-line: #8a5a0045;

  --gradient: linear-gradient(90deg, #0b7a4e, #1f5fbf);
  --card-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(11, 26, 20, 0.04); /* one hairline, never more */

  --chrome-scanline: transparent;          /* no scanlines in Daylight */
  --chrome-bracket-display: none;          /* no corner brackets */
  --chrome-glow: rgba(11, 122, 78, 0.04);
  --chrome-grid-line: rgba(11, 26, 20, 0.035);
}
```

### Contrast

Both ramps are tuned to the same rungs, so a component that reads correctly in one theme
reads correctly in the other. Contrast vs. the theme's `--bg-base`:

| Token | Mission | Daylight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--text-heading` | 17.5 | 16.8 | titles |
| `--text-body` | 13.5 | 12.4 | body copy |
| `--text-muted` | 7.5 | 7.4 | descriptions |
| `--text-subtle` | 6.5 | 6.6 | subtitles, mono metadata |
| `--text-label` | 5.5 | 5.8 | section labels, stat labels |
| `--text-dim` | 4.6 | 4.7 | footer chrome, backlink |
| `--accent-ink` | 13.2 | 5.0 | accent text, icons, borders |

**Every rung clears AA (4.5:1), including `--text-dim`.** That is deliberate: almost
everything on the bottom three rungs is 12px Share Tech Mono, and Share Tech Mono has
hairline stems that go grey and blurry on a 1× display. Contrast is what buys those
stems back. `--text-dim` is still the lowest rung — use it for footer chrome and the
rising.company backlink, not for form placeholders (use `--text-label`).

`--accent` (`#3af0a0`) is a **fill**, not an ink, in Daylight: 1.4:1 on white. Use it as a
button/badge background with `--accent-on` text, never as text or a 1px border on light.

### Theme-conditional chrome

| Effect | Mission | Daylight |
|---|---|---|
| Scanlines | required | off |
| Corner brackets | required on full-bleed HUD views | off |
| Atmosphere grid | on — mint glow over a 48px grid | on, but near-invisible (`--chrome-grid-line` @ 3.5%) |
| Elevation | background shift only (`--card-shadow: none`) | background shift + one hairline (`--card-shadow`) |

Page margins, spacing, radii, type and motion are **identical in both themes** — only the
four rows above differ.

Daylight drops the HUD texture on purpose. The brand carries in Daylight through the
Share Tech Mono labels, the `//` prefix, the mint, and the spacing — not through darkness.

---

## Fonts

Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Share+Tech+Mono&family=Rajdhani:wght@300;500;700&display=swap

- Display/Content: "Rajdhani", sans-serif — weights 300, 500, 700
- System/Technical: "Share Tech Mono", monospace

**Font roles** — Share Tech Mono for HUD readouts (labels, stats, badges, eyebrows,
footers, buttons, metadata). Rajdhani for human content (titles, descriptions, body).
Unchanged across themes.

## Colors

Reference the variables above rather than literal hex. Raw values, per theme:

### Backgrounds
| Token | Mission | Daylight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bg-base` | `#0a0c10` | `#f6f8f7` | page background |
| `--bg-surface` | `#0d1117` | `#ffffff` | cards, panels, elevated containers |
| `--bg-surface-hover` | `#0f1520` | `#eef3f0` | interactive surface hover |
| `--bg-inset` | `#0a1410` | `#e8f5ee` | badge backgrounds, recessed areas |

### Borders
| Token | Mission | Daylight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--border` | `#1a2a20` | `#dde5e0` | card borders, dividers |
| `--border-hover` | `#2a4a38` | `#9dc4b0` | card hover borders |
| `--border-subtle` | `#1a3020` | `#e6ede9` | badge borders, faint separators |
| `--border-grid` | `#111820` | `#e9efeb` | background structural lines |

### Text
| Token | Mission | Daylight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--text-heading` | `#e8f4ff` | `#0b1a14` | page/card titles |
| `--text-body` | `#c8d8e8` | `#26332d` | primary body text |
| `--text-muted` | `#84a89a` | `#43564c` | descriptions, secondary body |
| `--text-subtle` | `#7d9b8c` | `#4a5d54` | subtitles, secondary mono |
| `--text-label` | `#6e8f80` | `#52655b` | section labels, stat labels, placeholders |
| `--text-dim` | `#61856d` | `#61746b` | footer chrome, backlink — decorative only |

### Accents
| Token | Mission | Daylight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--accent` | `#3af0a0` | `#3af0a0` | brand fill (button/badge background) |
| `--accent-hover` | `#6ff7be` | `#22dc8c` | `--accent` under hover — keeps `--accent-on` text |
| `--accent-ink` | `#3af0a0` | `#0b7a4e` | accent text, icons, 1px borders |
| `--accent-on` | `#08150f` | `#08150f` | text on top of `--accent` |
| `--accent-2-ink` | `#2a7adf` | `#1f5fbf` | secondary accent |
| `--danger-ink` | `#ff4a24` | `#c02a10` | error / destructive |
| `--warning-ink` | `#f5b83d` | `#8a5a00` | warning / caution |

### Derivatives & chrome
Every accent also carries a wash and a line; these are real tokens, not values to
recompute at the call site.

| Token | Mission | Daylight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--accent-wash` | `#3af0a014` | `#0b7a4e12` | selected / active surface wash |
| `--accent-line` | `#3af0a050` | `#0b7a4e45` | accent border |
| `--accent-bracket` | `#3af0a040` | `#0b7a4e30` | corner brackets |
| `--danger-wash` | `#ff4a2414` | `#c02a1012` | error banner background |
| `--danger-line` | `#ff4a2450` | `#c02a1045` | error banner border |
| `--warning-wash` | `#f5b83d14` | `#8a5a0012` | caution background |
| `--warning-line` | `#f5b83d50` | `#8a5a0045` | caution border |
| `--gradient` | mint → blue | deep green → blue | card hover bar |
| `--card-shadow` | `none` | `0 1px 2px rgba(11,26,20,0.04)` | elevation |
| `--chrome-scanline` | `rgba(0,0,0,0.04)` | `transparent` | scanline stripe |
| `--chrome-bracket-display` | `block` | `none` | corner bracket visibility |
| `--chrome-glow` | `rgba(58,240,160,0.05)` | `rgba(11,122,78,0.04)` | atmosphere radial |
| `--chrome-grid-line` | `rgba(17,24,32,0.7)` | `rgba(11,26,20,0.035)` | atmosphere grid |

`--accent-2`, `--danger` and `--warning` also exist as full-strength fills (identical in
both themes) alongside the `-ink` variants above — use the fill as a background with dark
type, the ink as text or a 1px border.

### State Recipe
Any accent derives the same way — no extra tokens needed:
- Background wash: accent-ink @ 8% alpha (hex suffix `14`, or `12` on light)
- Border: accent-ink @ 31% alpha (hex suffix `50`, or `45` on light)
- Text/icon: `--accent-ink` at full strength

Examples — selected row: `--accent-wash` bg / `--accent-line` border / `--accent-ink` text.
Error banner: `#ff4a2414` / `#ff4a2450` / `#ff4a24` in Mission; `#c02a1012` / `#c02a1045` /
`#c02a10` in Daylight.

## Text Styles

| Style | Family | Size | Weight | Letter-Spacing | Transform | Color |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Eyebrow | Share Tech Mono | 12px | normal | 0.2em | uppercase | `--accent-ink` |
| Hero Title | Rajdhani | `clamp(36px, 7vw, 56px)` | 700 | 2px | uppercase | `--text-heading` |
| Page Title | Rajdhani | 36px | 700 | 3px | uppercase | `--text-heading` |
| Section Heading | Rajdhani | 28px | 700 | 2px | none | `--text-heading` |
| Card Title | Rajdhani | 20px | 700 | 1px | none | `--text-heading` |
| Lede | Rajdhani | 18px | 500 | normal | none | `--text-muted` |
| Body | Rajdhani | 15px | 500 | normal | none | `--text-muted` |
| Stat Value | Share Tech Mono | 17px | normal | 0.06em | none | `--accent-ink` |
| Subtitle | Share Tech Mono | 13px | normal | 0.1em | none | `--text-subtle` |
| Section Label | Share Tech Mono | 12px | normal | 0.2em | uppercase | `--text-label` |
| Button | Share Tech Mono | 12px | normal | 0.1em | uppercase | per variant |
| Badge | Share Tech Mono | 12px | normal | 0.05em | none | `--text-label` |
| Footer | Share Tech Mono | 12px | normal | 0.1em | none | `--text-dim` |

Line-height: headings 1.1 · lede 1.5 · body 1.6 · mono metadata 1.5–1.9.

### Two rules hold the mono scale together

Both exist for 1× (non-Retina) displays, where most of this system is actually read:

**12px is the floor for Share Tech Mono. Nothing smaller, ever.** Its stems are roughly
7% of the em, so below 12px they sample to under one device pixel on a 1× monitor and
render as grey blur. The identical text looks crisp on a Retina laptop, which is why the
floor has to be a rule rather than a judgement call — the display you designed on is not
the display it ships to. Rajdhani body copy has a matching floor of 15px, at weight 500
(400 is not in the font link, and 300 is far too light at text sizes).

**Mono tracking is expressed in `em`, never `px`.** Tracking that reads as deliberate HUD
spacing at 12px reads as disconnected characters at 10px; `em` pins the ratio whatever the
size. `0.2em` is the widest rung in the system — past about a quarter of an em the eye
stops resolving words and starts spelling out letters.

## Spacing

- Page: 48px — header, main, side padding (24px below 768px)
- Landing section: 96px — vertical rhythm between landing-page bands (64px below 768px)
- Section: 32px — between major sections inside an app view
- Element: 24px — card padding, landing-footer vertical padding
- Grid: 16px — grid gap between cards, app-footer vertical padding
- Inline: 12px — gap between badges
- Tight: 8px — between related text elements

## Border Radius

- Card: 6px — cards, panels
- Control: 4px — buttons, inputs, tooltips
- Badge: 3px — badges, small tags

## Motion

**Animation quality is the first priority of Rising Company design.** Motion is the first
thing a person feels on a screen and the first thing that reads as cheap when it is wrong —
one mistimed panel undoes careful type and color in a single frame. So motion is designed,
not added. Before an animation is written, answer five questions: what moves, why, how it
enters, how it leaves, and what it does under reduced motion. If any of them has no answer,
the element does not animate. **A still view beats a careless one.**

Motion is identical in Mission and Daylight — same curves, same distances, same durations.

### Library — Motion (motion.dev), required

Everything beyond the CSS hover/focus transitions below is built on
[Motion](https://motion.dev) — `npm i motion`. One engine and one set of curves, so every
product moves the same way.

- React: `import { motion, AnimatePresence, MotionConfig, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"`
- Vanilla / non-React: `import { animate, stagger } from "motion"`
- Do not hand-roll animation — no `setTimeout` choreography, no `requestAnimationFrame`
  loops, no class-toggle sequences — and do not add a second engine (GSAP, react-spring,
  anime.js). Static CSS `transition` stays for hover, focus and color; that is what it's for.

Wrap every React app root once:

```jsx
<MotionConfig reducedMotion="user" transition={{ type: "spring", visualDuration: 0.3, bounce: 0 }}>
  {children}
</MotionConfig>
```

`reducedMotion="user"` turns off transform and layout animation for people who asked for
it and keeps opacity — the same contract as the CSS block at the end of this section. The
default transition is a critically damped spring: natural deceleration, interruptible, no
overshoot.

### Scale

Durations and curves are a scale, like spacing. Pick from it; do not invent a value.

| Tier | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Quick | 0.2s `ease` (CSS) · `{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }` | hover, focus, color, border, opacity — the transitions on every control |
| Base | `{ type: "spring", visualDuration: 0.3, bounce: 0 }` | anything that moves or resizes: menus, panels, drawers, toasts, list rows, layout changes |
| Slow | `{ type: "spring", visualDuration: 0.5, bounce: 0 }` · 0.6s `ease` (CSS load reveal) | whole surfaces: page reveal, route transition, modal and scrim |
| Ambient | ≥ 2.4s `ease-out`, looping | the status pulse — and nothing else |

- **Springs move, tweens fade.** Anything with a position or size uses the spring; opacity
  and color use the Quick tween. Springs are interruptible — a hover-out halfway through a
  hover reverses from where it is, not from the end.
- **Exits are faster than entries** — about 0.6× the entry and fade-led:
  `exit: { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }`. Nothing pops out of existence;
  conditionally rendered elements sit inside `AnimatePresence`.
- **`bounce: 0`, always.** Nothing bounces, overshoots or wobbles. The brand is an
  instrument panel, not a toy.
- Stagger 40–90ms per item and cap the whole sequence at 600ms. Past eight items, batch —
  a 30-row table does not enter one row at a time.

### Distances

Small. Motion suggests where something came from; it does not travel there.

- Enter / reveal — sections, cards, toasts: `y: 8 → 0` with opacity.
- Menus, tooltips, popovers: `y: 4 → 0`, `scale: 0.98 → 1`, growing from their anchor via
  `transformOrigin`.
- Never scale from 0. Never slide from off-screen unless the element lives off-screen (a
  drawer or sheet) — then translate the panel at Base and fade the scrim at Quick.

### Rules

1. **Motion has a job** — reveal, confirm, orient (where did this come from) or connect
   (this became that). Name the job in the code. If you can't, cut the animation.
2. **Transform and opacity only.** `x`, `y`, `scale`, `rotate`, `opacity`. Never animate
   `width`, `height`, `top`, `left`, `margin`, `padding`, `box-shadow` or `filter`. Size and
   position changes go through Motion's `layout` prop, which runs them as transforms.
3. **Never block input.** Nothing waits on an animation; a user can click through a reveal.
   Nothing runs longer than Slow except the status pulse.
4. **One entrance per view.** The page reveals, or the panel opens — a section that is
   revealing does not also stagger the cards inside it.
5. **Loops are for live state.** The status dot pulses because the system is live. A
   skeleton may breathe on opacity at Ambient. Nothing else loops, shimmers or spins except
   a spinner.
6. **Reduced motion is a state, not a fallback.** Every animation has a defined reduced
   version — transforms off, opacity kept, content at its final state. Verify it by
   toggling the OS setting, not by assumption.
7. **60fps on a 1× machine.** Test with DevTools CPU throttling at 4×. If it drops frames,
   simplify: fewer elements, no blur, no `layout` on long lists. `will-change` only on the
   element about to move, and removed after.
8. **Review it in motion.** A screenshot cannot approve an animation. Watch it live before
   merging — entrance, exit, interruption (toggle it mid-flight) and reduced motion.

### Recipes

Panel / menu — the user menu, popovers, toasts:

```jsx
<AnimatePresence>
  {open && (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4, scale: 0.98 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 4, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }}
      style={{ transformOrigin: "top right" }}
    />
  )}
</AnimatePresence>
```

Staggered list — cards, results; cap at eight:

```jsx
<motion.ul initial="hidden" animate="show" variants={{ show: { transition: { staggerChildren: 0.06 } } }}>
  {items.map((item) => (
    <motion.li key={item.id} variants={{ hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 8 }, show: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }} />
  ))}
</motion.ul>
```

Layout change — a card growing, a row leaving:

```jsx
<motion.div layout />
```

Vanilla, no React:

```js
import { animate, stagger } from "motion"
animate(".card", { opacity: [0, 1], y: [8, 0] }, { type: "spring", visualDuration: 0.3, bounce: 0, delay: stagger(0.06) })
```

### CSS transitions

Hover, focus and color states on controls stay in CSS — Quick tier, default `ease`:

```css
transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
```

Properties: border-color, background, color, opacity, transform. Nothing else.

### Load Reveal (optional)

Staggered boot-up on page load — sections fade up in document order: opacity 0 → 1,
translateY 8px → 0, 0.6s ease, 90ms stagger per section. CSS keyframes on a static page;
`variants` with `staggerChildren: 0.09` in an app. One reveal per page — it is the page's
entrance, not each component's. Under `prefers-reduced-motion`: animation none, content
fully visible.

### Reduced motion (required)

`rising.css` ships this; every product keeps it, alongside `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"`:

```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
}
```

## Interaction States

### Focus Ring (required)
Keyboard focus only — style via `:focus-visible`, never plain `:focus`:
```css
:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }
```

### Text Selection (required)
```css
::selection { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-on); }
```

### Disabled
No new colors — reuse the low-emphasis ramp: text/icon `--text-label`, border
`--border-subtle`, background unchanged. No hover transitions, `cursor: not-allowed`.

## Visual Effects

### Scanlines (Mission only)
Fixed overlay, `pointer-events: none`, `z-index: 100`. Driven by the theme token, so the
same rule is inert in Daylight:
```css
body::before {
  content: ""; position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 100;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    transparent 0px, transparent 3px,
    var(--chrome-scanline) 3px, var(--chrome-scanline) 4px
  );
}
```

### Corner Brackets (Mission only)
32x32px L-shaped borders at viewport corners. Border color `var(--accent-bracket)`,
positioned 16px from edges, `display: var(--chrome-bracket-display)`.

### Card Hover Gradient
2px bar at card top: `var(--gradient)`. Hidden (`opacity: 0`) by default, `opacity: 1` on hover.

### Card Elevation
Apply `box-shadow: var(--card-shadow)` unconditionally. Daylight has no dark field to sit
on, so it resolves to one hairline (`0 1px 2px rgba(11, 26, 20, 0.04)`); Mission resolves
it to `none`, where elevation is background shift only. One rule, both themes.

---

## Components

### Button

Mono, uppercase, tracked. Three variants plus danger; three sizes.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary">Send magic link</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary">Add to calendar</button>
<button class="btn btn-ghost">Cancel</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" disabled>Sending…</button>
```

```css
.btn {
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace;
  font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
  cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
}
.btn-sm { font-size: 12px; padding: 9px 18px; letter-spacing: 0.075em; }
.btn-lg { font-size: 13px; padding: 17px 34px; letter-spacing: 0.15em; }

/* Solid — the loud one. One per view. */
.btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-on); border-color: var(--accent); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); }

/* Wash — the HUD default for in-app actions */
.btn-secondary { background: var(--accent-wash); color: var(--accent-ink); border-color: var(--accent-line); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-surface-hover); border-color: var(--accent-ink); }

/* Neutral */
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-body); border-color: var(--border); }
.btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-surface-hover); border-color: var(--border-hover); color: var(--text-heading); }

.btn-danger { background: transparent; color: var(--danger-ink); border-color: var(--danger-ink); }
.btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-ink); color: var(--bg-base); }

.btn[disabled], .btn[aria-busy="true"] {
  color: var(--text-label); background: transparent;
  border-color: var(--border-subtle); cursor: not-allowed;
}
.btn-block { display: flex; width: 100%; }
```

**Which variant:** `btn-primary` is reserved for the single most important action on a
view — a landing hero CTA, the submit on an auth form. Inside Mission app chrome, prefer
`btn-secondary`; a solid mint slab is too loud repeated. `btn-ghost` for everything else.

### Form Field

The label has no `//` — fields are items in a set; the prefix goes on the label that opens
the form (`// Sign in`), once. See "// Prefix Convention".

```html
<div class="field">
  <label class="field-label" for="email">Email</label>
  <input class="input" id="email" type="email" placeholder="you@company.com"
         autocomplete="email" required>
  <p class="field-help">We'll send a sign-in link — no password.</p>
</div>

<div class="field is-error">
  <label class="field-label" for="email2">Email</label>
  <input class="input" id="email2" type="email" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="email2-err">
  <p class="field-error" id="email2-err">Not a valid address.</p>
</div>
```

```css
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.field-label {
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-label);
}
.input {
  font-family: "Rajdhani", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-body); background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 13px 14px; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
}
.input::placeholder { color: var(--text-label); font-weight: 400; }
.input:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--bg-surface-hover); }
.input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }
.input[disabled] { color: var(--text-label); border-color: var(--border-subtle); cursor: not-allowed; }

.field-help  { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5; }
.field-error {
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--danger-ink);
}
.field.is-error .input { border-color: var(--danger-ink); }
```

Inputs use 16px text — anything smaller triggers zoom-on-focus in mobile Safari. Never
use `--text-dim` for a placeholder.

### Card
Structure: tag (category · subcategory, no `//`) → title → description → badge row
- Container: `background: var(--bg-surface)`, `border: 1px solid var(--border)`, radius 6px, padding 24px
- Hover: `background: var(--bg-surface-hover)`, `border-color: var(--border-hover)`, gradient top-bar opacity 1
- Gradient bar: absolute, top 0, left 0, right 0, height 2px, `background: var(--gradient)`
- Arrow indicator: absolute, bottom 24px, right 24px, mono, `var(--border-hover)` → `var(--accent-ink)` on hover
- Elevation: `box-shadow: var(--card-shadow)` — a hairline in Daylight, `none` in Mission

### Badge
- Font: Share Tech Mono, 12px, letter-spacing 0.05em
- `background: var(--bg-inset)`, `border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)`, radius 3px, padding 3px 7px
- Color: `var(--text-label)`

### Stats Panel
Vertical stack of stat rows:
- Label: Share Tech Mono, 12px, letter-spacing 0.1em, uppercase, `var(--text-label)`
- Value: Share Tech Mono, 17px, letter-spacing 0.06em, `var(--accent-ink)`

### Tooltip
- `background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-base) 92%, transparent)`, `border: 1px solid var(--accent-line)`, radius 4px, padding 8px 12px
- Name: 15px, weight 700, `var(--text-heading)`, letter-spacing 1px
- Material line: Share Tech Mono, 12px, `var(--accent-ink)`, letter-spacing 0.1em
- Description: 13px, `var(--text-muted)`, line-height 1.5

### Page Header
The per-view heading, one per page, directly under the app bar. Not the app bar itself —
see "App Shell" under Page Patterns for the difference.
- Structure: eyebrow → page title (actions on the same baseline, right) → subtitle
- Inside `.app-main` (which already carries the 48px page padding): `padding-bottom: 24px`,
  `margin-bottom: 32px`, `border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border)`
- Standalone at the top of a page with no app bar: `padding: 48px 48px 32px`

### Footer
Two footers, one voice. `.site-footer` is the landing page's; `.app-footer` is the
signed-in product's (see "App Shell"). Both:
- Font: Share Tech Mono, 12px, `var(--text-dim)`, letter-spacing 0.1em
- `border-top: 1px solid var(--border)`; 24px vertical padding on the landing footer,
  16px on the app footer
- Must include the rising.company backlink — see below.

### Status
Live-state readout: a 6px dot + mono label (`ONLINE`, `SYNCING`, `3 PENDING`).
- Dot: `var(--accent)`, pulses a `--accent-line` ring every 2.4s (off under reduced motion)
- `.is-degraded` → `var(--warning)` dot, `.is-down` → `var(--danger)` dot, no pulse
- Label: Share Tech Mono, 12px, 0.1em, uppercase, `var(--text-label)`

### Grid Layout
- `display: grid`; `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))`; `gap: 16px`

### HUD Overlay (Mission only)
Full-viewport overlay with `pointer-events: none` containing scanlines, 4 corner brackets,
and content blocks positioned absolute (title top-left, stats top-right, legend bottom-left,
controls bottom-right).

---

## Page Patterns

### Landing Page (Daylight)

A user-facing product needs a landing page before it needs a login box. Required order:

1. **Nav** — wordmark left; links + one `btn-sm` CTA right. 64px tall, `border-bottom: 1px
   solid var(--border)`, sticky, `background: var(--bg-base)`.
2. **Hero** — eyebrow (`// Rising Company`) → hero title → lede (one sentence, ≤ 90 chars) →
   action row (`btn-primary btn-lg` + `btn-ghost btn-lg`) → mono trust line
   (`NO PASSWORD · NO CALENDAR ACCESS · FREE`). Max-width 720px for centered heroes.
3. **Proof strip** — one row of mono stats or a single-line quote. Optional.
4. **How it works** — 3 numbered steps. Reuse the `01 / 02 / 03` mono numerals from the
   section-head pattern; each step is a title + one line of body.
5. **Feature grid** — 3 cards, `minmax(280px, 1fr)`.
6. **CTA band** — `background: var(--bg-inset)`, full-bleed, `border-block: 1px solid
   var(--border-subtle)`. Section heading + one `btn-primary btn-lg`.
7. **Footer** — column links + the rising.company backlink.

Vertical rhythm between bands: 96px (64px below 768px). Every band's inner content shares
one `max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; padding-inline: 48px` container.

```html
<section class="hero">
  <div class="eyebrow">// Rising Company</div>
  <h1 class="hero-title">Huddle</h1>
  <p class="lede">Find a meeting time without the back-and-forth. Share one link.</p>
  <div class="hero-actions">
    <a class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" href="#start">Start a huddle</a>
    <a class="btn btn-ghost btn-lg" href="#how">See how it works</a>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-trust">No password · No calendar access · Free</div>
</section>
```

```css
.hero { text-align: center; max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 96px 0 64px; }

/* No margin on the title itself — hero rhythm comes from .hero .lede below, so
   .hero-title stays reusable in auth panels and anywhere else. */
.hero-title {
  font-family: "Rajdhani", sans-serif; font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(36px, 7vw, 56px); letter-spacing: 2px; line-height: 1.1;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-heading);
}
.lede { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text-muted); }
.hero .lede { margin: 16px auto 0; max-width: 52ch; }
.hero-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 32px; }
.hero-trust {
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-label); margin-top: 24px;
}
```

### Auth Screen

**A bare centered form on an empty field is not an auth screen** — it gives a first-time
visitor nothing to decide with. Two sanctioned layouts:

**Split (default for user-facing products)** — 50/50 above 900px, stacked below. Left: the
pitch (eyebrow, product name, one-line lede, 3 mono checkpoints marked `+`). Right: a surface card
holding the form. The pitch panel may use `background: var(--bg-inset)` to separate it.

**Centered (staff / operator sign-in)** — a single `max-width: 400px` surface card:
eyebrow → product name → one-line purpose → field → `btn-primary btn-block` → helper text →
backlink. Only appropriate when everyone signing in already knows what the product is.

```html
<main class="auth">
  <section class="auth-pitch">
    <div class="eyebrow">// Rising Company</div>
    <h1 class="hero-title">Huddle</h1>
    <p class="lede">Find a meeting time without the back-and-forth.</p>
    <ul class="auth-points">
      <li>One link — everyone marks their times</li>
      <li>No calendar access required</li>
      <li>Works for people without an account</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

  <section class="auth-panel">
    <div class="card auth-card">
      <div class="section-label">// Sign in</div>
      <div class="field">
        <label class="field-label" for="email">Email</label>
        <input class="input" id="email" type="email" placeholder="you@company.com" autocomplete="email">
        <p class="field-help">We'll email you a sign-in link. No password to remember.</p>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-block btn-lg">Send magic link</button>
      <a class="rising-backlink" href="https://rising.company" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">rising.company</a>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>
```

```css
.auth { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; min-height: 100vh; }
.auth-pitch, .auth-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 48px; }
.auth-pitch { background: var(--bg-inset); border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.auth-points {
  list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 32px 0 0;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--text-subtle);
}
.auth-points li::before { content: "+"; color: var(--accent-ink); margin-right: 10px; }
.auth-card { max-width: 400px; width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  /* min-height: 0 releases the 100vh floor once stacked, or the two panels
     add up to two full screens. align-items centers the card in the panel. */
  .auth { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: 0; }
  .auth-pitch { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); padding: 64px 24px 48px; }
  .auth-panel { padding: 48px 24px 64px; align-items: center; }
}
```

Copy rules for auth: say what the product does *before* asking for an address; name the
mechanism ("we'll email you a link — no password"); never let the button be the only text
on screen.

### App Shell (both themes)

The chrome behind the auth boundary. Every signed-in Rising product uses the same three
pieces so that moving between products feels like moving between rooms of one building:

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [mark] PRODUCT · CONTEXT    NAV NAV NAV        ● ONLINE  [BC] who ⌄  │  app-bar   56px, sticky, --bg-surface
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ // EYEBROW                                                        │
│ PAGE TITLE                                        [ action ]      │  page-header
│ subtitle · mono                                                   │
│ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ content                                                           │  app-main   --bg-base, 48px padding
│                                                                   │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ // PRODUCT · BUILD 2026-09-18 · 0a7d685      STATUS  PRIVACY  RISING.COMPANY │  app-footer 16px, --bg-surface
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

1. **App bar** — `56px` min-height, sticky, `background: var(--bg-surface)`, `border-bottom:
   1px solid var(--border)`, full-bleed with the 48px page gutter. Three slots, left to right:
   - **Brand** — the favicon mark (24px, from `branding/favicon.svg`) + the product name as a
     `.wordmark` at 18px. Links to the product's home route. The mark carries the Rising
     identity, so the name is the product's own — there is no `// Rising` eyebrow up here.
     Optional `.app-context` after it (mono, `--text-label`, `·`-separated) names the tenant,
     workspace or environment: `· RISING COMPANY`, `· STAGING`.
   - **Nav** — the product's top-level sections as mono 12px uppercase links, `--text-label`,
     hover `--accent-ink`. The current one takes `aria-current="page"`: `--text-heading` with a
     1px `--accent-ink` rule under it. Three to five links; more than that is a sidebar product.
   - **Session** — right-aligned: an optional `.status` readout, then the **user menu**. Its
     trigger shows identity at a glance — a 24px initials chip, the email in mono `--text-subtle`
     (truncates at 24ch, hides below 640px; the chip stays), a chevron. The panel opens
     under it, right-aligned: `// Signed in as` + full email, then the product's account items
     (Settings, Switch organization, …), then **Sign out** last, ruled off, `--danger-ink` on
     hover. Sign-out is always the bottom item so muscle memory carries across products. Status
     stays outside the menu — it is system state, not user state. The reference build is
     `<details>`/`<summary>` (no JS needed; add light-dismiss on outside click and Escape); a
     framework may use its own popover but keeps the classes and the item order.
2. **Page header** — inside `.app-main`, one per view. See the component entry above.
3. **App footer** — `background: var(--bg-surface)`, `border-top: 1px solid var(--border)`,
   `padding: 16px 48px`, mono 12px `--text-dim` uppercase. Left: `// PRODUCT · BUILD <date> ·
   <sha>`. Right: two or three links at most (status, privacy, docs) and the rising.company
   backlink last. It is a status strip, not a sitemap. Pinned to the viewport bottom on short
   pages by `.app { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh }`.

Rules:
- **Chrome is surface, content is base.** Bar and footer sit on `--bg-surface`; the view sits
  on `--bg-base`. That one-step lift is the whole hierarchy — no shadows, no heavier borders.
- **Both bars are full-bleed.** An app is not width-limited like a landing page. A view that
  wants the 1080px column puts `.shell` inside `.app-main`, not around the bars.
- **The app bar is not the landing nav.** `.nav` is 64px on `--bg-base` with a CTA button;
  `.app-bar` is 56px on `--bg-surface` with none. Switch at the auth boundary, with the theme.
- **Don't put account controls anywhere else.** Email, settings, org switching and sign-out
  live in the user menu, top-right, in that order — never in the page header, never spread
  along the bar — so an operator's eye never has to hunt for the exit.
- **Corner brackets are for viewport-scale surfaces** (auth, HUD overlays, maps). The bar and
  footer already frame the app; don't add brackets on top of them.
- **Sidebar products** (os, safe) keep the sidebar for module navigation. The slots relocate,
  they do not change: brand + context at the sidebar top, session + build + backlink at the
  sidebar bottom, and no app footer — the sidebar bottom *is* the footer.
- Below 768px the bar becomes two rows — brand + session, then the nav scrolling sideways —
  and the gutters drop to 24px. Below 640px the context and email hide; the footer centers.

```html
<body class="app">
  <header class="app-bar">
    <a class="app-brand" href="/" aria-label="Huddle home">
      <img src="https://design-system.rising.company/branding/favicon.svg" alt="">
      <span class="wordmark">Huddle</span>
    </a>
    <span class="app-context">Rising Company</span>
    <nav class="app-nav" aria-label="Primary">
      <a href="/huddles" aria-current="page">Huddles</a>
      <a href="/templates">Templates</a>
      <a href="/settings">Settings</a>
    </nav>
    <div class="app-session">
      <span class="status">Online</span>
      <details class="user-menu">
        <summary class="user-menu-trigger" aria-label="Account menu">
          <span class="user-initials" aria-hidden="true">BC</span>
          <span class="user-menu-email">ben@rising.company</span>
          <span class="user-menu-chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </summary>
        <div class="user-menu-panel">
          <div class="user-menu-head">
            <div class="section-label">// Signed in as</div>
            <div class="user-menu-email">ben@rising.company</div>
          </div>
          <a class="user-menu-item" href="/settings">Settings</a>
          <a class="user-menu-item" href="/orgs">Switch organization</a>
          <button class="user-menu-item user-menu-signout" type="button">Sign out</button>
        </div>
      </details>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="app-main">
    <div class="page-header">
      <div class="eyebrow">// Huddles</div>
      <div class="page-header-row">
        <h1 class="page-title">Your huddles</h1>
        <a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="/huddles/new">New huddle</a>
      </div>
      <p class="subtitle">3 open · 12 closed</p>
    </div>
    …
  </main>

  <footer class="app-footer">
    <span>// Huddle · build 2026-09-18 · 0a7d685</span>
    <span class="app-footer-links">
      <a href="/status">Status</a>
      <a href="/privacy">Privacy</a>
      <a class="rising-backlink" href="https://rising.company" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">rising.company</a>
    </span>
  </footer>
</body>
```

```css
.app { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh; }
.app-main { flex: 1; position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 48px; }

.app-bar {
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 60;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px;
  min-height: 56px; padding-inline: 48px;
  background: var(--bg-surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.app-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--text-heading); text-decoration: none; }
.app-brand img, .app-brand svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 4px; }
.app-brand .wordmark { font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 3px; }
.app-context {
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-label); white-space: nowrap;
}
.app-context::before { content: "·"; margin-right: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); }

.app-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.app-nav a {
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-label); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap;
  padding-block: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
}
.app-nav a:hover { color: var(--accent-ink); }
.app-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text-heading); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-ink); }

.app-session { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; margin-left: auto; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* User menu — <details>/<summary>; a framework may swap in its own popover
   but keeps the classes and the item order. */
.user-menu { position: relative; }
.user-menu > summary { list-style: none; }
.user-menu > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.user-menu-trigger {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 0; cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-subtle); transition: color 0.2s;
}
.user-menu-trigger:hover, .user-menu[open] > .user-menu-trigger { color: var(--text-heading); }
.user-menu-email {
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  max-width: 24ch; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
}
.user-initials {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 4px; flex-shrink: 0;
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent-wash); border: 1px solid var(--accent-line);
}
.user-menu-chevron {
  width: 8px; height: 8px; border-right: 1px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor;
  transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg); transition: transform 0.2s;
}
.user-menu[open] .user-menu-chevron { transform: translateY(2px) rotate(225deg); }
.user-menu-panel {
  position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 8px); right: 0; z-index: 70;
  min-width: 240px; padding: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-hover);
  border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
}
[data-theme="daylight"] .user-menu-panel { box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(11, 26, 20, 0.12); }
.user-menu-head { padding: 8px 10px 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.user-menu-head .section-label { letter-spacing: 0.15em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.user-menu-head .user-menu-email { max-width: none; color: var(--text-body); }
.user-menu-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 10px; border-radius: 4px; text-align: left;
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-label); background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s;
}
.user-menu-item:hover { background: var(--bg-surface-hover); color: var(--text-heading); }
.user-menu-signout { margin-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px; padding-top: 12px; }
.user-menu-signout:hover { color: var(--danger-ink); }

.status {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-label); white-space: nowrap;
}
.status::before {
  content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent);
  animation: status-pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite;
}
.status.is-degraded::before { background: var(--warning); animation: none; }
.status.is-down::before { background: var(--danger); animation: none; }
@keyframes status-pulse {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-line); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px transparent; } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent; }
}

.page-header { padding-bottom: 24px; margin-bottom: 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.page-header .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.page-header .subtitle { margin-top: 8px; }
.page-header-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.app-footer {
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px 24px; padding: 16px 48px;
  background: var(--bg-surface); border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-dim);
}
.app-footer a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; }
.app-footer a:hover { color: var(--accent-ink); }
.app-footer-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .app-main { padding: 24px; }
  .app-footer { padding-inline: 24px; }
  .app-bar { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 24px; padding-inline: 24px; min-height: 0; }
  .app-brand, .app-session { min-height: 56px; }
  .app-nav { order: 3; flex-basis: 100%; gap: 20px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; padding-bottom: 10px; }
  .app-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .app-nav a { padding-block: 2px 4px; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .app-context, .user-menu-trigger .user-menu-email { display: none; }
  .app-footer { justify-content: center; text-align: center; }
}
```

Copy rules for the shell: the product name in the brand, never "Rising" (the mark says that);
the exit is `Sign out` in every product — no "Disconnect", "Log out" or other variants; the
footer ident is `// PRODUCT · BUILD <date> · <short sha>` so a screenshot always says which
build it came from.

### Empty State
Eyebrow → one-line explanation in `--text-muted` → one `btn-secondary`. Centered, max-width
420px, 96px vertical padding. Never a bare "No results."

---

## Brand Assets

All brand imagery lives in `branding/` and is served from
`https://design-system.rising.company/branding/`. Reference it by URL or copy the file into
the product — never redraw the mark.

| File | Size | Alpha | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `favicon.svg` | 64×64 viewBox | yes | Browser tab icon. Preferred favicon — scales cleanly. Dark base, rounded corners baked in. |
| `favicon.png` | 512×512 | yes | Raster fallback for the favicon, PWA manifest icons, OG/social thumbnails. Rounded corners baked in. |
| `favicon-xl.png` | 1024×1024 | yes | Same mark at 2× — app-store listings, splash screens, any place asking for ≥512px. |
| `apple-icon.png` | 180×180 | no (opaque) | `<link rel="apple-touch-icon">` and Next.js `app/apple-icon.png`. Square corners on purpose — iOS applies its own mask; a pre-rounded or transparent icon shows black wedges. |
| `rising-logo-white.png` | 2026×898 | no (white bg) | Horizontal wordmark (arrow + "RISING COMPANY"). Daylight surfaces only, on `--bg-surface` white. |
| `rising-logo-transparent.png` | 909×393 | **no** — checkerboard is baked in | Do not place on a page. Reference only until a real transparent export replaces it. |

Rules:

- The mark is the mint→blue rising arrow (`#3af0a0` → `#2a7adf`) on `--bg-base` `#0a0c10`.
  Tab and app icons always use the dark base, in both themes — the icon is not themed.
- Wire favicons in the `<head>`:

```html
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="https://design-system.rising.company/branding/favicon.svg">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="https://design-system.rising.company/branding/apple-icon.png">
```

- Next.js App Router: copy `favicon.png` → `app/icon.png` and `apple-icon.png` → `app/apple-icon.png`;
  the framework emits the `<link>` tags itself.
- Wordmark on Mission (dark) surfaces: there is no dark-safe wordmark yet — use the
  favicon mark plus the product name set in Rajdhani, not `rising-logo-white.png`.
- Minimum clear space around the mark: the arrow's own width on all sides. Minimum
  rendered size: 16px (favicon) / 120px wide (wordmark).

---

## Rising Company Backlink (required branding)

Every Rising Company product must include a subtle backlink to https://rising.company:
- Target: https://rising.company, opens in new tab (`target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`)
- Text: "rising.company" (lowercase, standalone) or wrap an existing "rising company" mention
- Style: footer mono token — Share Tech Mono, 12px, 0.1–0.2em letter-spacing, `var(--text-dim)`, uppercase if standalone
- Hover: transition to `var(--accent-ink)` over 0.2s, no underline
- Placement: auth screens (below the form, 24–48px gap), app layouts (last link in the
  `.app-footer`, or the sidebar bottom near logout), landing/marketing pages (inline within
  the site footer copy)

```css
.rising-backlink {
  font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.2s;
}
.rising-backlink:hover { color: var(--accent-ink); }
```

---

## Voice & Tone

Identical in both themes. Daylight is lighter in *value*, not in tone.

### // Prefix Convention
`//` is the system speaking *about* what follows — a comment, not content. **It opens a
region, once.**

Use it on the first line of a region when that line frames what sits under it:
- the eyebrow over a page or hero title — `// Rising Company`, `// Huddles`
- the label that opens a group — `// Sign in` over a form, `// Materials` over a legend,
  `// Signed in as` at the head of a menu, `// No huddles yet` on an empty state
- the footer ident — `// Huddle · build 2026-09-18 · 0a7d685`

Never on:
- **data** — a status, count, date, category, material. `OPEN · 5 REPLIES`, `BRASS / COPPER`
  — not `// OPEN · 5 REPLIES`.
- **items in a set** — card tags in a grid, list items, table heads, form field labels. If it
  would repeat across uniform siblings it belongs on the set's label or nowhere. A form gets
  one `// Sign in`; its fields are `Email`, `Workspace`.
- **controls** — nav links, buttons, tabs, menu items.
- **what is already framed** — titles, the wordmark, a subtitle sitting under a `//` eyebrow.

Budget: a screen carries a handful. More than about four in one viewport means some are
decorating data, and the mark has stopped meaning anything.

### Case Rules
- Uppercase: eyebrows, section labels, page/hero titles, stat labels, buttons
- Normal case: card titles, body text, descriptions, tooltip content, ledes, help text

### Copy Style
- Terse technical fragments for chrome; **plain sentences for anything a stranger reads.**
  Landing ledes, help text, and error messages are written for humans, not operators.
- Em dashes (—) over commas for joining
- Middle dot (·) as inline separator: "SYSTEM A · SYSTEM B"
- No exclamation marks. No emoji. No casual language.

### Layout Philosophy
- **Theme-appropriate ground:** Mission's darkness is a feature; Daylight's white is a
  feature. Neither is empty space. 48px page margins in both.
- Sparse grids: auto-fill responsive, ample gap. Content breathes.
- Layered depth: Base → Surface → Surface Hover. Elevation through background shifts;
  Daylight adds one hairline shadow, never more.
- Motion is designed, not added — see "Motion". Subtle interaction: 0.2s transitions,
  border shifts, gradient reveals, springs with `bounce: 0`. Nothing bounces.
- Scanlines and brackets are Mission-only. Do not port them to Daylight.
